propositions: GitHub code-scanning alert #88 flags the upstream-URL assertion in test_notice_names_pandoc_its_version_and_its_licence for incomplete URL substring sanitization because bare substring containment (in operator) accepts lookalike hosts like https://pandoc.org.evil.com (suffix) or https://notpandoc.org (prefix)
The existing assertion uses bare containment checks ('pandoc.org' in text or 'github.com/jgm/pandoc' in text) which do not anchor the host boundaries, violating security-conscious URL validation

The fix replaces bare substring checks with a scheme+host-anchored negative-lookahead regex that explicitly rejects both suffix-style and prefix-style lookalike hostnames while accepting legitimate pandoc and github URLs

The anchored regex pattern uses (?![\w.-]) after pandoc.org and (?![\w-]) after the github path to prevent matching when a hostname character follows, blocking pandoc.org.evil.com and jgm/pandoc-extras while allowing valid URLs
Test passes and alert closes after the regex-based fix is merged without dismissing the alert
